caption: The drawing shows a single wooden chair with a high, decorative backrest. The chair is predominantly dark brown or black in color, with four turned legs and several turned stretchers connecting them. The backrest features four vertical slats and a top rail with a heart-shaped cutout in the center, as well as two finials at the top corners. The seat is woven in a straw or rush material, forming a triangular pattern that meets at the center. The background of the drawing is off-white and empty, with no other objects visible. There is a small, circular stain or mark on the lower right side of the paper. The overall composition centers the chair with clear details of its construction and texture.
title: High Back Chair
